load_ytvis_json: load YTVIS JSON annotations from a file into Detectron2 dataset dicts for video instance segmentation
register_ytvis_instances: register a YTVIS dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for training or evaluation
get_ytvis_2019_meta: get metadata including thing classes, colors, and id mappings for the YTVIS 2019 dataset categories
get_ytvis_2021_meta: get metadata including thing classes, colors, and id mappings for the YTVIS 2021 dataset categories
visualize_ytvis_dataset: visualize YTVIS dataset annotations by drawing bounding boxes and segmentations on video frames
